title: Analysis code: stage-associated gene expression in colorectal cancer reflects tumour composition
description: R pipeline reproducing all analyses, figures and supplementary tables: TCGA-COAD/READ download, ESTIMATE and CMS composition, DESeq2 models with and without composition adjustment, Hallmark GSEA, external validation in GSE39582 and GSE17536, random-effects meta-analysis, survival models, LASSO stage classifier and limma-voom sensitivity analyses.
